title: Miracles of Supernatural Abundance in the Last Days
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the plan of God for the last days, where the wealth of the wicked is transferred into the hands of God's people to fund His work and bring supernatural abundance and prosperity. Join us as Pastor Chris teaches on the biblical principles of God's abundance and provision, and how He is releasing it upon His people in this season. Listen as Pastor Chris shares a fresh word of faith and expectation, calling forth a harvest of wealth, properties, and businesses into the lives of God's people.
